newsitem.title: USA: Essex Property files shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: Essex Property files shelf registration.

text.p: Essex Property Trust Inc on Wednesday said it filed a new shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue up to $175 million of shares of common stock, preferred stock, depositary shares representing preferred stock and warrants to purchase shares of common and preferred stock.
In a statement, the company said the Registration Statement is not yet effective.

The company currently has approximately $25 million capacity remaining on a previously filed shelf registration statement which registered shares of common stock, preferred stock, depositary shares representing preferred stock and warrants to purchase shares of common stock and preferred stock.

Assuming the Registration Statement becomes effective, the company said it plans to use the proceeds from any future public offering of such securities for general corporate purposes, including funding acquisition and development activities and the repayment of indebtedness.
